topic: Shisui secretly stops the Uchiha massacre with Kotoamatsukami and vanishes, uncredited
title: Shisui Saved The Uchiha Clan And Vanished
description: What if Danzo's ambush on Shisui failed? This is the theory that he stops the Uchiha massacre with Kotoamatsukami, pays for it with his own eyesight, and vanishes without anyone ever knowing. Watch the full story on the channel.
comment: Do you think Shisui actually won that night, or just traded one tragedy for a quieter one? Pick one.

lines.text: Shisui saved the entire Uchiha clan. Nobody ever thanked him for it.

shot.fallback: lone ninja standing in shadow, unrecognized

lines.text: Here's the theory: Danzo's ambush was supposed to kill him by the Naka River.

shot.fallback: shadowy ninja ambushing a rival by a river at night

lines.text: I think it fails instead, and that one failure stops the massacre before it starts.

shot.fallback: ninja standing unharmed after an ambush

lines.text: Shisui uses Kotoamatsukami, a mind control technique so clean the victim never even notices.

shot.fallback: eye technique casting an invisible, absolute command

lines.text: One use on Danzo. One more on Fugaku. The whole coup folds without a single kunai thrown.
But that technique burns through its own user, and a third forced use finally costs Shisui his eyesight.

shot.fallback: ninja paying the ultimate price for his power

lines.text: So he vanishes anyway, blind and exiled, officially dead to protect the secret.

shot.fallback: ninja walking away into exile, blind

lines.text: Even Itachi still believes his best friend killed himself by that river.

shot.fallback: ninja mourning someone secretly still alive

lines.text: The clan survives. Nobody ever finds out who actually saved them.

shot.fallback: a rescue nobody is allowed to acknowledge

lines.text: That's the real theory here: saving everyone doesn't mean anyone finds out you did it.

shot.fallback: the core theory illustrated through its aftermath

lines.text: Which is exactly why Shisui saved the entire Uchiha clan, and nobody ever thanked him for it...

shot.fallback: a quiet hero content without recognition

self_check.loop: last line restates and loops back into line 1's claim
